name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Lateral Raise
research: Working (left) arm copies the owner-approved lateral_raise angles: start elev 8 / plane 20 / elbow 15, end elev 88 / plane 20 / elbow 18, tilt 0 -> 18, collarbone 0 -> 5 (S1 Campos 2020: side 30.3, rear 24.0, front 21.2 % MVIC; S2 ACE: to shoulder height, elbows soft and leading, shoulder blades down). Right hand grips an upright post (library step), arm held still: elev 70, plane 15, elbow 15 forward. Post position arithmetic (torso frame, upper arm 0.27 m, forearm+hand to fist centre 0.33 m): du = (-sin70 cos15, sin70 sin15, -cos70) = (-0.908, 0.243, -0.342); fold = (0.228, 0.970, 0.086); forearm = du cos15 + fold sin15 = (-0.818, 0.486, -0.308); fist = shoulder R (-0.22, 0, 0) + 0.27 du + 0.33 forearm = (-0.735, 0.226, -0.194) -> world (x, -0.02 - y, 1.44 + z) = (-0.735, -0.246, 1.246). Post = box 0.05 x 0.05 x 1.6 m standing on the floor under that point. Post hand axis vertical (thumb up), 18 deg off square to the forearm (forearm z -0.308). Feet standing rest (ankles +-0.13, z 0.074). Camera yaw +30 so the working arm faces the camera. Facts: research/single_arm_dumbbell_lateral_raise.json.
